description: Defines the NotificationManager struct responsible for managing user notifications in a macOS application, including requesting permission, configuring content, and handling notification delivery with support for entitlement checks.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct providing functionalities for sending local notifications with configurable content and priority levels in a macOS environment.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a user notification with specified title, body, sound, and priority, handling permission requests and entitlement checks.
